decision.risk_assessment: Low volatility consolidation with negligible trading volume. Risk of chop/whipsaw is elevated during low-volume periods.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH maintain an overarching bullish EMA structure (EMA 9 > EMA 21 > EMA 50) with strong ADX readings, but short-term momentum shows ongoing pullbacks with negative MACD histograms and prices pinned below EMA 9. Combined with near-zero trading volume, risk-reward does not warrant entering new positions until volume returns and momentum confirms a bullish continuation.
